name: comark-ui
description: Comark plugins by onmax: annotated screenshots, zoom, carousels, tabs and code groups, copy and wrap buttons on code, GitHub callouts, includes, embeds, and a linter. One version for every package.

scripts.gallery: pnpm build && node docs/build.ts && node e2e/serve.ts
scripts.doctor: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run doctor && pnpm run lint:docs
scripts.ready: vp fmt && pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm run doctor
scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm run doctor
scripts.deploy: pnpm docs:build && pnpm dlx wrangler deploy
